column1: # Stage S9 K3b: the identity and access domain (Discord sign-in, session tokens, the caller's own
# profile, the Arma link handshake) becomes api_identity_and_access.
# The domain folder becomes the crate's src/ whole (its README the source tree README) and its
# mod.rs the crate root. The module prefix is one `crate::` row scoped to the moved folder (first:
# a file two rows of one prefix both reach takes the earlier row), one `crate::` row scoped to the
# API source and one `api::` row scoped to the API package (its integration tests and the
# staging-fixtures binary). Grouped use trees were split before the rows ran.
